about_the_game:
Mobilize all your knowledge and hit the jackpot by avoiding trick questions: experience the suspenseful atmosphere of WHO WANTS TO BE A MILLIONAIRE? on the set of your choice, with new question packs specific to this Deluxe Upgrade!

NEW QUESTION PACKS!
In addition to the original 6000 questions, the Deluxe Upgrade version offers more than 3000 additional questions:
  • General knowledge (2000 questions)
  • Art & Literature (+300 questions)
  • Entertainment (+300 questions)
  • Lifestyle (+300 questions)
  • Geography (+250 questions)
  • History (+150 questions)
  • Language (+200 questions)
  • Science (+200 questions)
  • Sport & Hobbies (+200 questions)
  • DC Comics (300 questions)
  • Olympic Games (300 questions)

EVEN FASTER!
The game is now playable in “QUICK” and “WITHOUT TIMER” modes, allowing you to answer in different ways for an optimal gaming experience: perfect for family fun!

IS THAT REALLY YOUR FINAL ANSWER?
